text_block_list.text:
Just as I returned from shopping for supplies—
Rulership was talking with someone.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
All right, right on time.
Thank you for the delivery today, Umasan.
choice_data_list: UmaEats? I'll help carry it too.
UmaEats? I'll help carry it too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? Sorry to trouble you, Trainer.
Could you take the other bag too, then?
choice_data_list: Got it, that's quite a lot, huh

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well, they're not just for me.
Now then, shall we head back to our castle?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Ah, delicious. Both the scent of roses and the refreshing taste are simply wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: It was tailor-made in France for my great-grandmother. ...I'm quite fond of it too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The colors are wonderful too. It matches the cup that Pisa-san gave me very nicely.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it is because this cup is French-made as well.
However... hehe. Half of the four were found
at an antique shop in Austria, you know.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I thought if we had four of them, we could host a tea party with matching cups...
so I just couldn't resist buying them.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ach so! Is that so?
Thank you very much for the wonderful souvenir.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No, didn't you give me a tin of cookies as a souvenir from Germany as well, Flash?
It's only natural we do the same for each other.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone.
I ordered hamburgers from Uma Eats today.
choice_data_list: No! In such an elegant place, that's a bit much...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry.
This gathering was meant to be like this from the start.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The Commoner Food Appreciation Club—Rose mentioned she knew nothing
about everyday street food, so our class gets together to eat it once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I have gained countless new insights.
I must express my gratitude to you all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Her Majesty has gotten much more accustomed compared to before. In the past, she even tried eating a hamburger with a knife.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I still remember the look on your face
when you were told to just bite right into
a fast-food chain's hamburger.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I am deeply ashamed.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Come now, both of you. Reminiscing about the past is fine and all, but if you don't eat soon, your food will get cold, you know?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Cheese, teriyaki, and bacon lettuce.
Please eat whichever one you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: There are so many varieties. I only ever go to burger joints out of social obligation, so these flavors are all so novel to me...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Same here. Besides, whether in Germany or Japan, I've always ordered healthy options."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Pouring orange sauce over a hamburger...
I had never conceived of such an idea,
nor did I know it could be so surprisingly delicious.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: It feels novel no matter how many times I eat it... The light, brioche-like bread, and the rich, lingering seasoningâ

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The merciless saltiness,
the junkiness you can't get from high-grade meat,
easy to eat, so you just keep reaching for more—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Now this is quintessential fast-food chain burger.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I couldn't have known until I actually
held it in my hands and tasted it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There is still much about the common world I do not know.
Thank you for broadening my horizons.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: You're welcome. Though honestly, I used to be pretty similar to Rose back in the day.
choice_data_list: (That's right, Ruler's family was upper-class too.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Every day was surrounded by the refined dishes
made by the housekeeper, or top-tier delicacies
ordered via delivery, but—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly... your board game friends were the ones
who introduced you to UmaEats and junk food, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Yeah, from that day on, my world changed color.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fast food, instant meals...
What a wonderfully convenient and functional pinnacle of human wisdom.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"That addictive junk food flavor is simply irresistible...
I've fallen completely under its spell."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Worlds expand from the bonds between people...
I think that's truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, it's served as a treasured companion
for the long years I've spent alone in my room.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Now she is with us, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Right now... thanks to that, every day is never boring.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: We can all get together to play board games, and it's always fun recommending junk food to everyone.
choice_data_list: What if everyone ends up acting like Ruler...?
Just be careful not to overeat.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Pisa and Flash-san know how to cook,
though it might not really suit Rose's style—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Even so, it'd be quite amusing if it came to that. If it does, why not throw a junk food party?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My... that sounds like such a lovely event.
I am sure it will make for unforgettable memories♪

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ah, no problem. I've calculated both the frequency and amount carefully so it won't interfere with races.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I look over them every time, and Ruler's
calculated figures are always precise and spot-on.
I see, it seems the master of the board is also skilled at managing calories. I couldn't help but be impressed.
